description: This file contains unit tests for the HiveMqtt3ConsumerActor class, specifically testing MQTT message consumption, header mapping, and message acknowledgment handling within a test environment.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ConsumerActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HiveMqtt3ConsumerActor, extending AbstractConsumerActorTest for MQTT v3 message handling.

methods.name: getConsumerActorProps
methods.description: Returns Props for creating the HiveMqtt3ConsumerActor with specified acknowledgement requests or payload mapping.

methods.name: getInboundMessage
methods.description: Constructs and returns a mock MQTT v3 publish message with a specified payload and header.

methods.name: verifyMessageSettlement
methods.description: Verifies if message acknowledgment or redelivery occurs as expected based on the test scenario.

methods.name: testHeaderMapping
methods.description: Validates that headers are correctly mapped from MQTT message to Ditto message.
